title: SpatialV3Result
description: Step-level position sequence for a Feldenkrais lesson

steps.description: Position and action for each step in the lesson

position.description: Full body configuration in plain language (e.g., 'Lying on back, both knees bent, feet flat on floor, right knee crossed over left, arms reaching to ceiling with palms together')

action.description: What the student does in this position (e.g., 'Tilt both arms to the left, head follows')

is_transition.description: True if this step is primarily about changing to a new position

is_rest.description: True if this step is primarily rest or scanning

position_summary.description: Deduplicated list of distinct body configurations used in the lesson, in order of first appearance, with alternate phrasings

position.description: Primary plain-language description of the body configuration

alternates.description: Other ways a student might describe or remember this position — visual, kinesthetic, common names, simpler phrasings
